nativeFactory: RecipeBookPage.init creates ImageButton(x,y,12,17,WidgetSprites(normal,highlighted),onPress,next/previous narration); harness creates the same original ImageButton with Component.empty() to keep icon-only appearance and avoid tooltip contamination.
sampling: Original opaque-or-transparent PNG12×17, no mcmeta, integer GUI scales1–3, nearest sampling; transparent texels composited against controlled gray ROI backgrounds.
statePrecedence: WidgetSprites two-identifier constructor maps enabled and disabled normal to normal, and both focused states to highlighted. ImageButton.extractContents uses isActive/isHoveredOrFocused.
webComposition: Previous/next anchors preserve web semantics. Numeric Button links and ellipsis extend the original recipe-book arrows/count layout. Native first/last arrows are hidden by RecipeBookPage; web callers may hide or disable links using normal props. No numeric button has a direct native pagination counterpart.
soundEvent: ui.button.click; ImageButton extends Button/AbstractButton; original sound asset/pitch1/gain0.25 reused.
